meta.title: Ideal Customer Profile Workshop | CommView
meta.description: Ideal Customer Profile workshop for B2B scale-ups. Turn customer evidence into a usable ICP for targeting, messaging, qualification and sales prioritisation.
secondaryKeywords: how to create an ideal customer profile

hero.sub: Turn customer data, commercial evidence and what your teams know into an ICP that helps Marketing target, Sales prioritise and the business make better choices about where to spend time and money.

sections.heading: What We Build in an Ideal Customer Profile Workshop
intro: The output is a shared definition of the customers the business should prioritise and the evidence behind that choice.

We bring together customer and commercial data, what Sales and Marketing are seeing, customer patterns and the realities of your proposition. The aim is not to create a fictional perfect customer. It is to make targeting and prioritisation materially clearer.
sections.notes: Do not state a fixed two-week duration or fixed price until commercially confirmed.

sections.heading: Why a B2B Ideal Customer Profile Does More Than Segment the Market
sections.intro: Segmentation tells you how the market can be divided. ICP helps you decide which part deserves disproportionate attention.

columns.title: Segmentation
items: Groups the market by shared characteristics
Useful for understanding structure and variation
Can leave many segments looking equally attractive

columns.title: Ideal Customer Profile
items: Prioritises the customers most likely to be a strong commercial fit
Connects attributes to buying and customer evidence
Helps Marketing and Sales decide where not to spend effort

sections.heading: How to Create an Ideal Customer Profile From Evidence
sections.intro: The useful question is not 'what does our ideal customer look like?' It is 'what evidence tells us where we create and capture the most value?'

steps.title: Data
steps.body: Look at the customers, opportunities and outcomes the business already has.

steps.title: Interviews
steps.body: Bring in the patterns Sales, Marketing, Product and customer-facing teams are seeing.

steps.title: Patterns
steps.body: Identify the attributes and circumstances that appear to affect fit, value and buying behaviour.

steps.title: Hypothesis
steps.body: Turn those patterns into a clear definition that can guide targeting and qualification.

steps.title: Test
steps.body: Use the ICP in real decisions and refine it when the evidence changes.

sections.heading: An ICP Template Is Only Useful If the Business Can Act on It

items.title: Written ICP
items.body: A clear definition of best-fit customers, including the attributes and conditions that matter.

items.title: Market view
items.body: A practical way to understand the size and shape of the opportunity the ICP represents.

items.title: Sales and Marketing playbook
items.body: Translate the ICP into targeting, qualification, messaging and prioritisation decisions.

items.title: Fit scorecard
items.body: A simple way to assess how closely an account matches the evidence behind the ICP.

items.q: What if we already have an ICP?
items.a: An existing ICP is useful evidence, not a reason to avoid revisiting it. We can test whether it still reflects the customers you win, retain and create value for, and whether Sales and Marketing actually use it. If the market, product or growth stage has changed, the ICP may need to change too.

items.q: How is an ICP different from a buyer persona?
items.a: An ICP describes the type of company or account that is the best commercial fit for a B2B offer. A buyer persona describes the people involved in the buying process, including their responsibilities, priorities and concerns. You can have several buyer personas inside one ideal customer profile.

items.q: What data do we need for an ICP workshop?
items.a: Useful inputs can include customer and opportunity data, revenue or retention patterns, win and loss information, sales feedback, customer interviews and product usage where available. Perfect data is not required. We make the evidence gaps visible and separate what the business knows from what still needs to be tested.

sections.heading: You do not need to target everyone who could buy.
sections.body: Build an ICP that helps the business decide who is worth pursuing and why.
